title: DeJig: McKnight: Art Collection
native_title: デジグ マックナイト ～アート・コレクション～
overview:
Born in Kansas in 1941. He began painting at age 13 and studied art at Wesleyan University and Columbia University. After graduating he worked at Time magazine for eight years. From 1972 he devoted himself to his art. In 1982 he took part in an exhibition as an "Easter Egg" artist for the White House and the Smithsonian Institution. In 1986 his work was selected for the permanent collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Starting in 1994, he created President and Mrs. Clinton's official Christmas card three years in a row.

This digital jigsaw puzzle game turns the bright, detailed paintings of Thomas McKnight - city views from terraces, seaside towns and Venetian canal scenes - into puzzles. Pick a painting from the Puzzle Select screen, choose 72 or 108 pieces and fit them together while a timer tracks your time. Each completed painting is shown with its title and a short description.

- 1 player

1941年カンザス州生まれ。13才より絵を描き始め、ウェスレイアン大学およびコロンビア大学にて美術を学ぶ。卒業後「タイム」誌に8年間勤務。1972年より創作活動に専念。1982年ホワイトハウスとスミソニアン博物館の「イースターエッグ」アーティストとして展覧会に参加。1986年メトロポリタン博物館の永久保存作品に選出される。1994年よりクリントン大統領夫妻のオフィシャルクリスマスカードを3年連続で制作。
